description.narrative: East and Horn of Africa regional programme. The programme improves collective action, resiliance, and wellbeing for children, adolescents, and youth through partnerhsips with regional CSOs, including a youth-led network.

title.narrative: Horn of Africa Case Study 2023: Voices of Youth in Policy Making Processes in Horn Of Africa

description.narrative: Development of the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD) Youth PolicyFramework ensure that young people in Horn of Africa have the fundamental right to actively andmeaningfully engage in all matters affecting their lives and well-being. The policy provides youngpeople with opportunities and experiences that support successful integration into society andenables them to be active members and agents of change. It further fosters consistency in theapproach taken by IGAD Secretariat in addressing youth related challenges across the region.

title.narrative: # of direct Southern partners supported, disaggregated by region/country

description.narrative: This indicator covers direct Southern partners. These are organisations with a contractual relationship with the project or organisations funded through the project. This only pertains to Southern-based organisations funded or supported within the current Strategic Partnership Agreement period between 2022 and 2025.This is a standard output indicator under the Strategic Partnership Agreement with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. It seeks to provide a sense of scale across change contributions funded by the agreement. Narrative case studies compliment the indicator to capture change contributions.
